title: Install WABT and radare2 CLI backends
description: Add concrete Docker installation for WABT and radare2 so WebAssembly and cross-backend CLI workflows can use real tools when enabled.
scope: WABT and radare2 Docker fragments, systemDeps, validation
action: Add WABT and radare2 install fragments, env defaults, symlinks, and validation commands.
implementation: For WABT, prefer distro package or pinned upstream release and validate `wasm2wat --version` plus `wasm-objdump --version` or help.
For radare2, use a pinned release/install route compatible with the base image and validate `radare2 -v` and `rabin2 -h`.
Set `WABT_PATH` and `RADARE2_PATH` Docker defaults to install roots or wrapper paths.
Keep radare2 optional/profile-gated if source install increases build time significantly.
Add generator tests proving fragments are detected and validation appears in the generated Dockerfile.

criteria: `wabt` dockerFeature has a real fragment or apt route.
`radare2` dockerFeature has a real fragment or explicit profile gate.
Generated Dockerfile contains validation commands for WABT and radare2 when features are enabled.
Readiness reports installed Docker defaults rather than only BYO paths.
convergence.verification: npm test -- --runTestsByPath tests/unit/backend-install-contract.test.ts tests/unit/backend-plan-plugins.test.ts && npm run docker:generate -- --dry-run
convergence.definition_of_done: WABT and radare2 are installable CLI backends instead of plan-only metadata.

risks: radare2 source builds can be slow and flaky; prefer pinned binaries/packages where available.
Distro WABT versions may lag; document selected version strategy.
findings: Added WABT default install fragment and radare2 optional profile metadata/validation route.
